releaseNotes: 📱 Fixed Case Form Keyboard: Keyboard no longer covers notes or the Create Case button.
👤 Delete & Suspend Agents: Admins can now suspend, unsuspend, or permanently delete accounts directly in the app.
🔄 Fixed App Updates: Fixed older versions (v1.5.1) not detecting the new update.
🌐 Fixed Website Display: Website now shows latest version properly without flickering.
